name: Sittra
source:
Sittra is a demon from Annwn who is characterized as being very intellectual and voluptuous. He is a very elegant demon and takes pleasure in things he finds beautiful. When it comes to romance, he likes a balance of play and seriousness.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/fragrance/fragrance.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
